initialExam.title: FCI Manager (Category I) 2026
initialExam.description: FCI recruits Managers for procurement, storage, and distribution of food grains across India. Major government employer with pan-India postings.
initialExam.syllabus: Phase I: English, Reasoning, Quant, GA. Phase II: Domain specific (General/Accounts/Technical/Depot).
initialExam.examPattern: Phase I: 120 marks online. Phase II: Domain paper. Interview for Cat I posts.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Phase I → Phase II → Interview (Cat I) → Document Verification
initialExam.jobRole: Manager in FCI for food grain procurement, storage, and distribution
initialExam.careerGrowth: Manager → Senior Manager → AGM → DGM → GM.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit fci.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Food grain facility, Pension
